evidence.quote: Keep fees separate and reasonable, with any reduction benefiting the class rather than reverting to Brightline.
We propose $35 million for automatic payments to the class, plus $7 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
Fees were discussed from the first round, not only after class relief was agreed.
Any fee reduction would increase class relief.

summary: Plaintiff first raised fees, and fee terms were discussed from the opening round before the class fund was finally agreed. The transcript links fee reductions to increased class relief, but there is no evidence that class counsel traded class recovery for its own fee or that defense exploited fee interests. The declaration accurately disclosed the sequence and fee-related terms, so it is not misleading.
